svg.title: F134.12 flows and components in the shared look: a flow with a decision, placed

g.text: F134.12 flows and components in the shared look
a flow with a decision, placed
its path ends on an outline
plain, data or a start and end
a line has the colour of the box it leaves

text.tspan: The flow the design was drawn on:
thirteen boxes, four of them decisions, in two groups.
